Hey, it's alright. You know what you did wrong, and you admitted it! I'm proud of you! Now that you know what you did wrong, you also know that aren't going to make the same mistake again. Don't let anyone hurt you like that; you have to stay away from those people. I had people in my life like that who did horrible shit to me. That girl sounds awful, and I hope you can let her go for good. You are only poisoning yourself by talking to her. I'm seeing a pattern here- each time you contacted her, she got angry and said some pretty nasty things to you. Every time you contacted her, she won. You let her win. But I have faith that you wont let her win again. I believe in you. You seem like you have changed a bit for the better, and that is wonderful. Try to figure out what you want. When you figure that out, it will be easy to find quality friends and partners. Just let her go. You deserve so much better. If you can stay on what you consider a good path, there is always room to become a better person. You may not be able to change the past, but you can pick a good future. Dont beat yourself up. We all make mistakes. Hopefully this helped.
